context.transcript:
Hi, Ruchali.
Can you tell me when the order for the new protective eyewear will be here?
We need the goggles next week because the workers on the factory floor will have to wear them to operate the new equipment.
Oh, I'm glad you brought it up.
The shipment of goggles is due to arrive on Monday morning and requires a manager's signature, but I'm leaving to go on vacation tomorrow.
Will you be able to sign for it?
No, sorry.
I'll be busy helping the technicians install the new equipment.
Why don't you ask Morty?
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Ruchali。
你能告诉我新的防护眼镜的订单什么时候能到吗？
我们需要护目镜，因为工厂车间的工人必须戴它们来操作新设备。
哦，我很高兴你提到了这件事。
护目镜的货运预计周一早上到达，需要经理签字，但我明天要休假了。
你能签收吗？
不，抱歉。
我会忙着帮技术人员安装新设备。
你为什么不问 Morty？
